note: Phase 9 (Slice 9C) Lighthouse runs, taken the way design/screens/phase7-lighthouse.json documents its own: mobile emulation (Lighthouse's default form factor), Chrome 152 headless, simulated throttling, signed in as the e2e navigator through a session cookie in --extra-headers, against `pnpm start` on the production build. The gate (locked plan section 8, Phase 7) is performance and accessibility >= 90 on the Board and the Case editor. `before` is the Phase 7 `after` column, so the two files line up; `after` is this slice on the same three routes.
tool: lighthouse 13.4.1 via npx, no --preset (mobile is the default form factor; 13.x rejects --preset=default)
port: http://localhost:3103 (the Slice 9C worktree's own server and database; the lead's chain was on 3000)
what-slice-9c-changed: Board rows are cards in a two-column grid on the phone and a five-column grid on a laptop, with the elapsed clock as a filled pill instead of a 6 px stripe. One element fewer per row, one class more; no measurable cost.

Cumulative layout shift is still 0 on all three routes. The dashboard's and the editor's sections became cards and the board's rows gained margins, all of it server-rendered in the first paint, so nothing arrives after hydration and moves anything (the Phase 7 fix that took the board from 0.121 to 0 is intact — the install banner is still below the list).

Twenty-four inline SVG icons entered the markup (section headings, tile squares, the search field, the export actions). They are drawn, not fetched: no request, no font, nothing for the CSP to refuse. Every one is aria-hidden, so no accessible name moved — the accessibility score is 100 on all three routes, as it was.

The three routes' performance moved by at most one point in each direction, which is inside this harness's run-to-run noise (a first attempt on /cases/new failed with Lighthouse's own NO_NAVSTART trace error and was re-run, as the tool instructs).

not-fixed.unused-javascript (93-95 KiB on the case: Unchanged from Phase 7: the React/Next runtime plus zod in the first client chunk. Slice 9C adds no dependency — the icon set is copied source, not a package — so this is the same figure it was.
not-fixed.legacy-javascript-insight (14 KiB): Next's own polyfills, chosen by the default browserslist. Phase 7's reasoning stands: narrowing the browser target would drop whatever the hospital's older devices run.
not-fixed.render-blocking-insight (50-130 ms): The single Tailwind stylesheet, which Slice 9C did not grow meaningfully — the new classes are utilities the build already emitted for other elements, plus one print rule.
not-fixed.bf-cache: Every page is Cache-Control: no-store on purpose: a clinical board must never be restored from the back/forward cache with stale rows. Lighthouse marks both failure reasons "Not actionable".
not-fixed.seo 63 / is-crawlable / llms-txt: The app sets robots noindex on purpose (a hospital tool behind a login). SEO is not a gate.
not-fixed.label-content-name-mismatch on the board: The shell's overflow trigger draws the user's initials inside a button whose accessible name is "Menu" (Slice 9B; the name is pinned by tests/e2e/board.spec.ts and the Phase 9 contract list). The initials span already carries aria-hidden; axe computes "visible text" without honouring it, so the rule fires anyway. Lighthouse weights the audit 0 and the category is 100. Flagged for the lead rather than fixed here: the file belongs to Slice 9B and the accessible name is a contract.
not-fixed.forced-reflow-insight, network-dependenc: Lighthouse 13 insights and lab metrics outside the plan's gate; none names a change Slice 9C introduced.
